name: Fungsi.id MCP
description: Search Indonesian job listings, company profiles, and city, province, category and job-type metadata through eight read-only MCP tools over Streamable HTTP; no account or API key required.

skills.name: Job Search
skills.description: Search Indonesian job listings by keyword with paginated results via the search_jobs tool.

skills.name: Job Detail Lookup
skills.description: Fetch a full job record by slug, including description, company, location and publish date (get_job).

skills.name: Company Profile Lookup
skills.description: Retrieve a company profile with website, description, cities and job categories (get_company).

skills.name: Company Job Listings
skills.description: List all open positions posted by a single company, paginated (get_company_jobs).

skills.name: Location Metadata
skills.description: List Indonesian cities and all 38 provinces with their open-job counts (list_cities, list_provinces).

skills.name: Category And Type Metadata
skills.description: List job categories and job types such as full-time and part-time with open-job counts (list_categories, list_job_types).
